metadata.source: Georgia Secretary of State; Georgia General Assembly (legis.ga.gov)
metadata.note: Curated manually. Certified measures reflect the Secretary of State's certification as of the generatedAt date. 'Potential' measures have passed the General Assembly but are not yet certified for the ballot. Vote results are added after the election is certified.

measures.title: Authorize Creation of Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund Amendment
measures.summary: Allow the state legislature to create and dedicate revenue to a fund titled the Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund.

enablingLegislation.title: Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund; authorize creation - CA

measures.title: Increase Acre Limit for Agriculture and Timber Conservation Use Property Tax Classification Amendment
measures.summary: Increase the maximum acreage of agricultural and timber property that can be classified as bona fide conservation use property, which is taxed at 40% of the land's value, from 2,000 acres to 4,000 acres.

enablingLegislation.title: General Assembly; increase maximum acreage to qualify for assessment and taxation as bona fide conservation use property - CA

measures.title: Require Nonpartisan Elections for Probate Judges Amendment
measures.summary: Require that probate judges be elected on a nonpartisan basis.

enablingLegislation.title: Local government; probate judges shall be elected in nonpartisan elections; provide - CA

measures.title: Georgia Homestead Exemption for Surviving Spouses and Children of Disabled Veterans Measure
measures.summary: Extend the homestead property tax exemption to the surviving spouses and minor children of disabled veterans.
measures.statusNote: Passed the House in March 2025 and the Senate in April 2026. The Governor must sign the bill for it to be referred to the ballot.

enablingLegislation.title: Georgia Homestead Exemption for Surviving Spouses and Children of Disabled Veterans
